artists.biography:
Asia is a British rock band. The band was formed in 1981 as a supergroup of four members from different progressive rock bands, namely John Wetton (former bassist/vocalist of such bands as King Crimson, Roxy Music, and Uriah Heep), Steve Howe (guitarist of Yes), Geoff Downes (keyboardist of Yes and The Buggles) and drummer Carl Palmer (of Emerson, Lake & Palmer, The Crazy World of Arthur Brown, and Atomic Rooster).
The band has gone through many line-up changes throughout its history, but in 2006 the original line-up reunited and still currently performs as Asia. A second band of former members, called Asia Featuring John Payne, exist in parallel as a continuation of the pre-2006 Asia line-up.

perplexity.description:
Asia's self-titled debut album, released in March 1982 on Geffen Records, is a landmark rock record that blended pop accessibility with progressive rock influences. Featuring founding members John Wetton (bass/vocals), Steve Howe (guitar), Geoff Downes (keyboards), and Carl Palmer (drums)—all veterans of major progressive acts—the album showcased a polished, radio-friendly sound that stood apart from the complex arrangements of their previous bands. Songs like "Heat of the Moment" and "Only Time Will Tell" exemplified the group's knack for catchy melodies, tight songcraft, and subtle instrumental flourishes, making the album a defining example of early 1980s pop-rock with progressive undertones.

Commercially, Asia was a massive success, spending nine weeks at number one on the U.S. Billboard album chart and becoming the top-selling album of 1982 in the United States, with over four million copies sold there and more than 10 million worldwide. The lead single, "Heat of the Moment," reached No. 4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped the Mainstream Rock chart, while "Only Time Will Tell" also became a Top 20 hit. The album's popularity was further amplified by heavy MTV rotation, and it remains Asia's best-selling and most influential release, setting the template for their subsequent work and earning a Grammy nomination for Best New Artist. Though some progressive rock fans were disappointed by its pop direction, Asia's debut is widely recognized as a commercial and cultural touchstone of its era.
